names.note: The calendar's own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Иоанн (Меньков), мч.`; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1920)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Александра пресвитера и мч. Иоанна (1920).»

attestations.note: The day’s eighth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line calls him «мч.», a martyr, and gives him no rank in the clergy, so no `office` is written and none was guessed. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» and «мч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*menkov*` is empty and a Cyrillic grep for «Меньков» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page carries troparia and kontakia for five of the memories it heads, and none under his name.
